image_description: A stylized, artistic image featuring three Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) against a textured, light-colored background. The largest fish is on the right, facing left, displaying characteristic black anterior and yellow posterior coloration. Two other fish are visible on the left, one partially obscured at the top and another at the bottom. The image contains overlaid text elements, including numbers at the top, a block of text in the center, and the word 'ROCKBEAUTY' at the bottom.
